title: is_int() on a string parameter guards an unreachable branch

ground_truth.statement: is_int() returns false for every string, so the 'integer' branch of classify() is unreachable and the check cannot distinguish any two inputs.

allowed.reason: Mago reports the same site twice, once for the assertion and once for the resulting condition. The second diagnostic is correct, not noise.

notes: First case of the corpus and the template for the others: one fixture, three expectations, one runtime proof.
